snippet.title: CLOCKED DLC - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
#clocked #videogame #trailer

Even if that's the aim of the game, we're not going to beat about the bush!
Here are the contents of this expansion:
- A new level to find, larger than the main level in the base game.
- A hidden level in the base game.
- 3 alternative endings, one of which requires you to finish the game at 100%.
- 15 new achievements.
- A new game mechanic and a new danger.
- A new NPC to keep you company.
- Lots of secrets to discover.

CLOCKED is on Steam now : https://store.steampowered.com/app/2807110/Clocked/

DLC SOON
